title: User Authentication - Successful Login
description: Verify that users can log in with valid credentials and are routed to their role-specific dashboards.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify that the user is authenticated successfully.
Verify the user is redirected to the correct dashboard based on their role (doctor, nurse, administrator).
Verify audit log records successful login with timestamp and user details.

title: User Authentication - Failed Login with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect username/email or password and appropriate error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username/email and/or password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login fails.
Verify an appropriate error message is displayed to the user.
Verify failed login attempt is recorded in audit logs.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users cannot access unauthorized routes or UI elements outside their permission scope.

steps.description: Log in as a nurse user.
Attempt to access administrator-only routes or UI components.
Verify access is denied with proper error or redirection.
Verify UI components editable only by administrators are not visible or disabled.
Verify audit logs capture denied access attempts.

title: Patient Registration and Lifecycle - Full Flow
description: Verify complete CRUD operations for patient registration, case recording, appointment booking, treatment, billing, and discharge workflows.

steps.description: Log in as staff user with patient management permissions.
Create a new patient record with valid details.
Verify patient details are saved correctly and visible in patient list.
Record a new case for the patient including medical history and symptoms.
Verify case details are saved and linked to the patient record.
Book an appointment for the patient with a doctor.
Verify appointment is scheduled and appears in both patient and doctor calendars.
Update the appointment details (reschedule).
Verify updated appointment info is saved and notifications are sent.
Record treatment details post-appointment.
Verify treatment records are saved and linked to the patient and appointment.
Generate and issue billing invoice for treatments and services.
Verify invoice is generated with correct calculations and saved.
Process payment and record transaction.
Verify payment is successfully recorded and invoice status is updated.
Discharge the patient.
Verify discharge workflow completes and patient status updates.

title: AI Virtual Nurse Assistant - Appointment Booking Intent
description: Verify that the AI assistant correctly identifies appointment booking intents and books appointments as expected.

steps.description: Open the AI virtual nurse chat interface.
Send a natural language message requesting to book an appointment with a specific doctor.
Verify AI assistant parses the intent accurately.
Verify AI assistant provides available time slots.
Select one of the suggested appointment slots.
Verify appointment is booked and confirmation is displayed.
Verify booking is reflected in patient and doctor schedules.

title: AI Virtual Nurse Assistant - Fallback Response When API Unavailable
description: Verify the AI assistant provides a meaningful fallback response when the OpenRouter AI integration is unavailable.

steps.description: Simulate the AI API being unavailable or network failure.
Send a natural language query to the AI assistant.
Verify the AI assistant responds with a predefined fallback message.
Verify user is informed about the temporary unavailability of AI services.

title: Inventory and Pharmacy Management - Low Stock Alert
description: Verify that low stock warnings trigger correctly when medicine or supplies inventory goes below threshold.

steps.description: Log in as pharmacy staff user.
Add inventory for a medicine item with stock level above alert threshold.
Verify no low stock alert is generated.
Dispense medicines reducing stock to below the low stock threshold.
Verify the system generates a low stock alert notification.
Verify alert appears on dashboard and email/SMS if configured.

title: Laboratory Test Ordering and Result Delivery
description: Verify ordering lab tests, tracking samples, uploading images, and delivering results to clinicians.

steps.description: Log in as a doctor.
Order one or more laboratory tests for a patient.
Verify test orders are saved and visible in lab module.
Track sample collection and status updates.
Verify sample statuses update correctly including received, processing, completed.
Upload images or reports related to laboratory or radiology tests.
Verify uploaded files are accessible and linked to the correct patient record.
Deliver test results to the ordering clinician.
Verify clinician receives notifications and results are properly displayed.

title: Billing Cycle - Invoice Generation and Payment Workflow
description: Verify invoice creation, payment processing, record keeping, and financial reporting correctness.

steps.description: Generate an invoice for patient treatments and services.
Verify invoice includes correct charges based on treatments.
Send invoice to patient via email.
Verify email delivery and invoice status updates to 'sent'.
Process payment through integrated payment gateway.
Verify payment transaction records and invoice status changes to 'paid'.
Generate financial reports including revenue, outstanding invoices.
Verify reports reflect accurate financial data matching transactions.

title: IoT Bed Sensor Data Flow and Real-Time Monitoring
description: Verify real-time bed sensor data is collected correctly and displayed on dashboards with RFID tracking.

steps.description: Simulate IoT bed sensor data transmission with patient presence status.
Verify data is received and processed by the system in real-time.
Verify bed availability and status is updated on real-time dashboards.
Attach RFID tags to assets and patients and simulate RFID scans.
Verify RFID tracking updates asset and patient location data correctly.

title: Telemedicine Session Scheduling and Management
description: Verify scheduling telemedicine sessions, remote consultations, session tracking, and video call integration placeholder.

steps.description: Log in as patient.
Schedule a telemedicine session with a doctor.
Verify session is created and confirmed for both patient and doctor.
Log in as doctor and join scheduled telemedicine session.
Verify session status updates to active and logs the participation.
Verify video call integration placeholder appears and is ready for future implementation.
End the telemedicine session.
Verify session is marked complete with session duration recorded.

title: Content Management System - CRUD Operations
description: Verify complete CRUD operations and validation for CMS public-facing content such as blogs, galleries, and careers.

steps.description: Log in as administrator.
Create a new blog post with valid content and metadata.
Verify the blog post is saved and published.
Edit the blog post with updated content.
Verify the changes are saved and live on the public site.
Delete the blog post.
Verify the blog post is removed from the public site and database.
Add and manage gallery images and career job postings with similar CRUD verification.

title: API Endpoint Compliance and Error Handling
description: Verify RESTful API endpoints conform to standards, return JSON, and handle errors gracefully for main modules.

steps.description: Send valid API requests to patient, appointment, doctor, billing, laboratory, and AI assistant endpoints.
Verify response status codes are 200 OK and JSON data structure is correct.
Send invalid requests with missing or malformed data.
Verify API returns appropriate error status codes (4xx) with descriptive JSON error messages.
Test unauthorized API calls without authentication tokens.
Verify API returns 401 Unauthorized responses.

title: Frontend Responsiveness Across Browsers and Devices
description: Verify UI layout, touch interactions, and component scaling on supported browsers and screen sizes using Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js.

steps.description: Open the hospital management system frontend on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari browsers.
Verify UI components render correctly without layout issues on desktop screen resolutions.
Resize browser window to tablet and mobile screen sizes.
Verify responsive UI adjustments, menus collapse, and controls remain usable.
Test on physical mobile devices with different OS (iOS, Android).
Verify touch interactions and navigation are smooth and consistent.

title: Security Features - Multi-Factor Authentication and Data Encryption
description: Verify multi-factor authentication (MFA) flows, encryption of sensitive data, and audit logging of security events.

steps.description: Enable MFA for a test user account.
Attempt login with correct credentials but without completing MFA step.
Verify login is blocked pending MFA verification.
Complete MFA step successfully.
Verify user is authenticated fully.
Inspect database records for sensitive data such as passwords and patient information.
Verify sensitive data are encrypted or hashed appropriately.
Trigger various security-relevant actions like login, logout, failed login attempts.
Verify audit logs capture these events with correct detail and timestamps.

title: Performance Testing - Page Load and API Response Times
description: Verify page load times are under 2 seconds and API responses are under 500 milliseconds under nominal load conditions.

steps.description: Navigate to main dashboard as different user roles.
Measure page load time and verify it is less than 2 seconds.
Send API requests to critical endpoints (patient data, appointments, billing).
Measure response time and verify it is less than 500ms.

title: Integration Testing for Payment Gateway, SMS, Email, and AI Services
description: Verify functional integration points with external services including payment gateways, SMS/email notifications, and AI assistant APIs.

steps.description: Initiate a payment through the integrated payment gateway.
Verify the payment completes successfully and appropriate records are updated.
Trigger an SMS notification (e.g., appointment reminder).
Verify the SMS is received by the intended recipient.
Send an email from the system (e.g., billing invoice).
Verify email delivery and correct formatting.
Invoke AI assistant API for medical query and appointment booking.
Verify responses are accurate and timely as expected.

title: Documentation and User Manuals Verification
description: Verify that all user manuals and documentation are up to date, complete, and cover all system features and administration tasks.

steps.description: Review the user manuals and online documentation.
Verify all major modules and features such as patient management, AI assistant usage, billing, and CMS are documented.
Verify documentation includes setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Verify documentation is consistent with the current system version and UI.
